data.content_ref: inline:Make the skeptical fixpoint incremental over warrant addition by maintaining a persistent union-find over defeat-equivalence classes and a versioned label array; when a new attack edge is materialized, only the strongly connected component of the changed edge is recomputed using a dynamic algorithm for the grounded extension of that component. This preserves the exact fixed point and polynomial amortized cost under bounded edits, but requires decomposability into components with no cross-component reinstatement; otherwise local recomputation can miss global reinstatement and needs a fixpoint over components.
